reason: The hypothesis synthesizes separate findings on precipitation-driven microstructural evolution (P1, P11) and corrosion/oxidation mechanisms (P3, P8, P22-P26) into a single, integrated proposal that links nanoscale intermetallic precipitation to both improved corrosion and high-temperature oxidation through a dual-layer oxide mechanism. This specific mechanistic coupling for Mg-containing lightweight HEAs is not stated in any single passage or textbook.
